strings: r_c0 has been called in by m_c's worried parent. Unfortunately, that worry was well-founded, as m_c seems to have wasting disease.
m_c seems weaker lately, unable to play as much or explore as far.
m_c is a sickly kit and the Clan fears {PRONOUN/m_c/subject} may not live past kithood. Even if {PRONOUN/m_c/subject} {VERB/m_c/do/does}, this sickness may never leave {PRONOUN/m_c/object}.
